request.amount_ada: none; the document states this action does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set a fixed Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for Treasury Withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
Record DRep agreement that the new limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same period.
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the 500,000,000 ada limit.
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The limit caps only the cumulative amount debited from the Cardano Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve allocations, protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada limit and are not reset, reversed, reopened, or re-authorized by this action.
The proposal says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but that practical room under it is becoming constrained.
The proposal says increasing the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals while maintaining a fixed guardrail and simple accounting.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal asserts that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are sufficient for DReps to agree a Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal states it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to the constitution.
The proposal asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to replace the prior 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 with a 500,000,000 ada cap on cumulative ledger-recorded Treasury Withdrawal debits, without directly authorizing any withdrawal.
